---
title: "Human endothelial cells: scVI handoff, annotation and subset review"
output: html_document
---

This notebook presents adapted excerpts from code used in my analysis for
**Characterisation of endothelial cells in progressive fatty liver disease in
humans**. It retains the Seurat-side analysis stages while excluding unpublished
data, marker panels, annotation decisions, group assignments and results.

The original notebook was exploratory, with saved-object dependencies and
alternative analysis branches. This is a methods portfolio, not a reproducible
release of the study. It has not been rerun against the private data. All chunks
have `eval=FALSE`; knitting shows code without running the analysis.

## Inputs and environment

Requires R with Seurat (an Assay5-compatible release for the export block),
UCell, dplyr, ggplot2, Matrix, clusterProfiler and org.Hs.eg.db. Leiden clustering
also requires the backend supported by the installed Seurat version. Exact
historical package versions were not captured by the source notebook.

Keep `local_inputs/` and `private_outputs/` outside version control. Supply:

- `endothelial_scvi.rds`: a Seurat object with RNA counts/data, an imported
  `scVI` reduction and an existing UMAP. scVI fitting itself is upstream.
- `analysis_settings.rds`: a named list with `pc_candidates`, `selected_pc`,
  `subset_label`, `group_column`, `group_order`, `exclude_clusters`,
  `contrast_ident_1` and `contrast_ident_2`; these are local analysis choices.
- `signature_panels.rds`: a named list of gene vectors for UCell scoring;
  `review_features.txt`: one locally selected gene per line.
- `broad_annotation.tsv` and `subset_annotation.tsv`: local tables with
  `cluster` and `label` columns, reviewed independently of this public excerpt.
- `enrichment_genes.txt` and `enrichment_background_entrez.txt`: local gene
  symbols and the tested background in Entrez IDs, respectively.

```{r setup, eval=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(UCell)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

set.seed(1234)
settings <- readRDS("local_inputs/analysis_settings.rds")
scvi_ec <- readRDS("local_inputs/endothelial_scvi.rds")
review_features <- readLines("local_inputs/review_features.txt")
gene_sets <- readRDS("local_inputs/signature_panels.rds")
dir.create("private_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Rebuild a Seurat neighbor graph from imported scVI embeddings

The source used embeddings imported into Seurat. A dimensional reduction is not
itself a Seurat neighbor graph, so the graph and clusters are rebuilt explicitly.
The existing imported UMAP is used for display; this block does not retrain scVI
or recompute that UMAP.

```{r scvi-graph, eval=FALSE}
md_scvi_ec <- scvi_ec
DefaultAssay(md_scvi_ec) <- "RNA"
scvi_mat <- Embeddings(md_scvi_ec, reduction = "scVI")
md_scvi_ec[["scvi_optimized"]] <- CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = scvi_mat, key = "scvi_", assay = "RNA"
)
md_scvi_ec <- FindNeighbors(
  md_scvi_ec, reduction = "scvi_optimized", dims = seq_len(ncol(scvi_mat))
)
md_scvi_ec <- FindClusters(md_scvi_ec, algorithm = 4, resolution = 0.8)
DimPlot(md_scvi_ec, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE,
        group.by = "seurat_clusters", pt.size = 1) + coord_fixed()
```

## Normalize expression for marker and signature review

Expression normalization and variable-feature selection support expression
review; they do not replace the imported scVI embedding used above.

```{r expression-review, eval=FALSE}
md_scvi_ec <- NormalizeData(
  md_scvi_ec, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000
)
md_scvi_ec <- FindVariableFeatures(
  md_scvi_ec, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000
)
md_scvi_ec <- ScaleData(md_scvi_ec, features = VariableFeatures(md_scvi_ec))
md_scvi_ec <- AddModuleScore_UCell(obj = md_scvi_ec, features = gene_sets)

FeaturePlot(md_scvi_ec, features = paste0(names(gene_sets), "_UCell"))
DotPlot(md_scvi_ec, features = review_features, cluster.idents = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
```

## Apply a locally reviewed annotation and select a subset

The actual cluster-to-cell-type mapping is withheld. The mapping below is read
from a local table and checked against the clusters present in the object.

```{r reviewed-annotation, eval=FALSE}
Idents(md_scvi_ec) <- "seurat_clusters"
annotation <- read.delim("local_inputs/broad_annotation.tsv",
                         colClasses = "character")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(annotation$cluster))
stopifnot(setequal(annotation$cluster, levels(md_scvi_ec)))
broad_cluster_ids <- setNames(annotation$label, annotation$cluster)
md_scvi_ec <- RenameIdents(md_scvi_ec, broad_cluster_ids)
md_scvi_ec$reviewed_annotation <- Idents(md_scvi_ec)
DimPlot(md_scvi_ec, group.by = "reviewed_annotation",
        reduction = "umap", label = TRUE, pt.size = 0.2)

Idents(md_scvi_ec) <- "reviewed_annotation"
ec_subset <- subset(md_scvi_ec, idents = settings$subset_label)
```

## Recluster the subset and compare PC choices

The original workflow normalized the subset again, inspected PCA diagnostics,
and compared multiple PC cutoffs. Its selection and biological interpretation
are not reproduced. The candidate cutoffs and selected cutoff are local inputs.

```{r subset-pca, eval=FALSE}
ec_subset <- NormalizeData(
  ec_subset, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000
)
ec_subset <- FindVariableFeatures(
  ec_subset, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 3000
)
ec_subset <- ScaleData(ec_subset, features = VariableFeatures(ec_subset))
ec_subset <- RunPCA(ec_subset, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(ec_subset, ndims = 50)
DimHeatmap(ec_subset, dims = 25:30, cells = 200, balanced = TRUE)

pc_review <- lapply(settings$pc_candidates, function(n_pc) {
  candidate <- FindNeighbors(ec_subset, dims = seq_len(n_pc), verbose = FALSE)
  candidate <- FindClusters(candidate, algorithm = 4, resolution = 0.8)
  candidate <- RunUMAP(candidate, dims = seq_len(n_pc),
                       min.dist = 0.5, verbose = FALSE)
  list(object = candidate,
       clusters = DimPlot(candidate, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE),
       groups = DimPlot(candidate, reduction = "umap",
                        group.by = settings$group_column))
})
names(pc_review) <- as.character(settings$pc_candidates)
ec_subset <- pc_review[[as.character(settings$selected_pc)]]$object
```

## Discover markers and inspect local gene panels

This is an exploratory cell-level marker workflow. It does not establish
donor-level differential expression or a validated disease signature.

```{r subset-markers, eval=FALSE}
Idents(ec_subset) <- "seurat_clusters"
subset_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  ec_subset, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25
)
write.table(subset_markers, "private_outputs/subset_markers.tsv",
            quote = FALSE, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE)
top20 <- subset_markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20, with_ties = TRUE)
DoHeatmap(ec_subset, features = unique(top20$gene))
FeaturePlot(ec_subset, features = review_features)
DotPlot(ec_subset, features = review_features, cluster.idents = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))

subset_annotation <- read.delim("local_inputs/subset_annotation.tsv",
                                colClasses = "character")
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(subset_annotation$cluster))
stopifnot(setequal(subset_annotation$cluster, levels(ec_subset)))
ec_subset <- RenameIdents(
  ec_subset, setNames(subset_annotation$label, subset_annotation$cluster)
)
ec_subset$reviewed_annotation <- Idents(ec_subset)
```

## Review composition by a local grouping variable

The source summarized pooled cell proportions. These descriptive plots should
not be interpreted as a donor-level statistical comparison. The actual group
labels, exclusions and counts are not included.

```{r composition, eval=FALSE}
composition_object <- ec_subset
Idents(composition_object) <- "seurat_clusters"
if (length(settings$exclude_clusters) > 0) {
  composition_object <- subset(composition_object,
                                idents = settings$exclude_clusters,
                                invert = TRUE)
}
metadata <- composition_object[[]]
metadata$analysis_group <- metadata[[settings$group_column]]
composition <- metadata %>%
  group_by(analysis_group, reviewed_annotation) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
ggplot(composition, aes(analysis_group, percent, fill = reviewed_annotation)) +
  geom_col() + theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

cell_ratio <- as.data.frame(prop.table(
  table(metadata$seurat_clusters, metadata$analysis_group), margin = 2
))
ggplot(cell_ratio, aes(Var2, Freq)) + geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~Var1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## Pairwise cluster comparison and ordered expression review

```{r pairwise-review, eval=FALSE}
Idents(ec_subset) <- "seurat_clusters"
pairwise_markers <- FindMarkers(
  ec_subset, ident.1 = settings$contrast_ident_1,
  ident.2 = settings$contrast_ident_2,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25, min.pct = 0.25, test.use = "wilcox"
)
pairwise_markers$gene <- rownames(pairwise_markers)
write.table(pairwise_markers, "private_outputs/pairwise_markers.tsv",
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
# FindMarkers produces one comparison, so do not group by a nonexistent
# cluster column when selecting the top features.
pairwise_top <- pairwise_markers %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 20, with_ties = TRUE)
DoHeatmap(ec_subset, features = pairwise_top$gene)

ec_subset[[settings$group_column]] <- factor(
  ec_subset[[]][[settings$group_column]], levels = settings$group_order
)
VlnPlot(ec_subset, features = review_features,
        group.by = settings$group_column, pt.size = 0)
```

## Exploratory functional enrichment

GO, KEGG pathway and KEGG module calls were present in the source. The gene lists
and findings are withheld. This adaptation requires an explicit tested-gene
background; the source's KEGG-module block referenced an undefined background.
Enrichment depends on that background and the installed annotation versions.

```{r functional-enrichment, eval=FALSE}
genes <- readLines("local_inputs/enrichment_genes.txt")
gene_ids <- bitr(genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID",
                 OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
background <- readLines("local_inputs/enrichment_background_entrez.txt")
go_enrich <- enrichGO(
  gene = gene_ids$ENTREZID, universe = background,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "BH", qvalueCutoff = 0.05
)
kegg_enrich <- enrichKEGG(
  gene = gene_ids$ENTREZID, universe = background,
  organism = "hsa", pvalueCutoff = 0.1
)
kegg_modules <- enrichMKEGG(
  gene = gene_ids$ENTREZID, universe = background,
  organism = "hsa", keyType = "kegg", pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH", minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 500, qvalueCutoff = 0.2
)
barplot(go_enrich, showCategory = 10)
dotplot(go_enrich)
dotplot(kegg_enrich)
barplot(kegg_enrich, showCategory = 10)
```

## Export a subset for a separate Scanpy/scVI analysis

The Matrix Market export retains genes by cells. The metadata row names are cell
identifiers; a downstream importer must preserve this order and transpose the
matrix if needed. These files contain private data and must not be committed.

```{r matrix-market-handoff, eval=FALSE}
raw_counts <- ec_subset[["RNA"]]$counts
stopifnot(identical(colnames(raw_counts), rownames(ec_subset[[]])))
writeMM(raw_counts, file = "private_outputs/subset_counts.mtx")
write.csv(ec_subset[[]], file = "private_outputs/subset_metadata.csv")
write.csv(rownames(ec_subset), file = "private_outputs/subset_genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

Package imports alone are not evidence that a method ran. In particular, the
source imported doublet-detection packages but did not run their methods in the
human annotation workflow above. No Harmony step is represented here.
